cash_breakdown.reason: The group has HKD907.162m revenue, HKD285.1m contracts in hand, nearly 1,000 employees, receivables and contract assets; not all cash can be removed.

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, FX and dividend friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: RMB funds, PRC dividend withholding tax exposure and unrecognised withholding tax on unremitted PRC earnings create extraction friction.
cash_breakdown.reason: Deducted after asset haircuts as a conservative friction reserve.

profit_quality.assessment: Positive but not clean free cash flow. Three-year parent profit declined from HKD59.756m to HKD47.856m to HKD29.808m, while three-year operating free cash flow was about HKD28.948m, HKD66.432m and HKD31.970m. The main case uses HKD32.0m pre-haircut distributable cash profit and a 0.60 haircut.
adjustments: Use three-year operating free cash flow evidence rather than the rough-screen net profit alone.
Treat 2025 HKD9.450m bank interest income and HKD33.731m government grants as lower-quality support to profit.

Do not add back all fair value losses on investment properties into sustainable cash profit because property valuation losses are non-cash but the related assets are not the software/system-integration operating engine.
Recognise receivable and contract-asset quality drag: 2025 net trade/bills receivables rose HKD31.413m and gross trade receivables include aged balances with HKD46.428m loss allowance.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: Net operating cash flow for 2023-2025 was HKD31.379m, HKD68.514m and HKD35.834m; capex was HKD2.431m, HKD2.082m and HKD3.864m.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Cash conversion is positive, but revenue is declining, profit relies meaningfully on grants/interest, and project receivables remain material.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Three-year FCF is positive, but 2024 benefited from working-capital release and 2025 receivables increased.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Capex is light; 2025 purchases of PPE were HKD3.864m and no material capital expenditure commitments were disclosed.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: System integration sales are credit-based, generally due within 90 days with retention receivables; trade/bills receivables and impairment allowance are material.
